what: Choice shown when the party taps a lit WALL torch: Take (carry it, goes to a hand) or Snuff (put it out). No text is baked in.
sizeNote: 52x31 px = 76x45 pt on iPhone 15 (1.456 pt/px; 30 px would be 43.7 pt, so 31). Text room at 52 px = 43 px (7 glyphs + shadow). An 8-glyph label is 47 px + 1 shadow, so stretch to 56 px (rule below). Current labels are at most 5 glyphs.

stretch.rule: draw at any w x h (w >= 52, h >= 31): corners 4x4 unscaled, edges/centre stretched NEAREST; width = max(52, textWidth + 9) where textWidth = glyphs*6-1 (+1 shadow, +8 frame)

bareIcons.take: icon_take.png (17x21: fist gripping a lit torch)
bareIcons.snuff: icon_snuff.png (17x21: smoke curl off a dead torch head)

labelByCode.font: font/font_5x7.png via font_5x7.json glyphs (Greek included; look Greek up by glyphs, not the ASCII formula)
labelByCode.position: x = (w - textWidth)//2 (+1 if textWidth is even), y = 12 = top of the 5x9 glyph box (caps on rows 12-18, Greek lower-case accents in box rows 0-1, descenders rows 19-20); pressed: +1 px down

suggestedPlacement.note: in the 3D view just above the panel, centred, clear of the arrows and hand buttons (all at y>=442)
suggestedPlacement.tapRule: consume the tap so it does not also hit the torch/view behind; ignore taps ~1 s after a flare/snuff like the torch tap lock
